{{Conjecture|legends}}
The '''government''' of [[Pembric II]] was established in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] when [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] was [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|removed]] from power by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. A [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], [[Crev Bombaasa/Legends|Crev Bombaasa]], set up the organization, which was essentially a puppet government that answered to him and his [[Bombaasa Cartel|criminal cartel]]. Publicly, the government proclaimed to be pro-Imperial to forestall any attempt by the New Republic to open diplomatic negotiations.
